body:

Framework `307ce4c4`. Maintainer-approved (dispatch session `session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi`, 2026-10-20). Wave anchor: #24579. Previous round: round 3 at `580fd4ed` (#24779 surface:api, #24786 surface:cli, #24787 surface:build). Sister records: #24838 (`upgrade:ceremony`) and the `tier1:24681-touched` record (close-out comment).

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework `307ce4c4b42503347d7f85825f572e4ca058b05f` (pinned, detached; no pull). No console build: every browser leg is `not-run (browser)`.
- Cold tree: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (21 s), `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (76/76, 7m29s), `check-dev-prereqs` green.
- Runner A (27 items, a runner subagent with its own port and DBs, clause verdicts re-read by the parent): port 41841 (41842 only for a local delay server in the RESUME_IN_PROGRESS probe); scratch root `/tmp/qa4/t2/`. Boot: `OS_PORT=41841 setsid pnpm -C DIR exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 41841 -d file:/tmp/qa4/t2/NAME.db`, stopped by the listener's process group. Install, `OS_CLOUD_URL=off`, scratch-app and connector items ran from a full scratch copy of `examples/app-showcase` (made with tar — `rsync` is not installed here). DBs: `p0.db` (4 boots), `dup.db`, `qasuite.db`, `bootb.db` (3 boots), `conn.db`, `conntwin.db`, `aiboot.db`.
- Runner B (the parent): `cli.dev-boot-contract` on a scratch copy at ports 41858/41859, DBs under `/tmp/qa4/dbc/`.
- Boot banner: `Tenancy: single` · `Flows: 32 flow(s) 19 bound to triggers (record_change, schedule, time_relative, api) · 8 draft` · `Seeds: com.example.showcase 132 rows`. On an info-level fresh boot: `[organization-ownership] a datastore created from empty: birth marker written (shape generation 1, platform 18.0.0-next.5)`. No second or third boot over an existing DB was refused by the ownership guard (3 restarts over p0.db, 2 over bootb.db, plus the seed-integrity, flow-disable, clone and marketplace restart legs).
- Afterwards `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/` holds only the pre-existing `data`; no `installed-packages/` (RUNNER install-escape check); `git status` clean.
- Timestamps (UTC, 2026-10-20): runner A 08:13–08:57; negatives completed 09:36–09:38 (from captured evidence, no new boots); runner B 09:17–09:26; expired-token leg 09:38.

## Scope

Selector `t2:24681-touched` — a maintainer-named set: the 28 items among the #24681-touched set whose surface is api / cli / build, that carry no `automated.ref`, at P0/P1. Revisions per row below. No item is `planned`.

## Result

12 PASS / 16 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN of 28. No clause failed; no authentication or authorization finding.

How negatives are scored: every `negative[]` entry gets a verdict. A negative that states only a runner or recording rule (no product expectation) is `not-run (procedural)`, so its item derives PARTIAL even when every product clause passed — 12 of the 16 PARTIALs are that and nothing else (named per row). Round 3 scored such negatives `pass` in its Tier 2 tables; the difference is the rule, not the product (see "Against round 3").
